name: Avoid Procedures with High Fan-Out (Easytrieve)
description:
Avoid Procedures with High Fan-Out (Fan-Out > X). The Fan-Out of an Artifact is the number of other Artifacts that are referenced in it. When computing the Fan-Out of an Artifact, multiple accesses to the same component of an Artifact are counted as one access.
The threshold is a parameter and can be changed at will.
For an Easytrieve Procedure, these Artifacts are the Procedures it performs and the Programs it calls with CALL or LINK.
output:
Associated to each Easytrieve Procedure with violations, the Quality Rule provides:
- The Fan-Out
rationale:
An Artifact that references many other Artifacts depends on all of them: it is harder to understand, to test in isolation and to reuse, and a change in any of them can break it.
Analyzability, changeability and testability decline with increasing Fan-Out.
reference:
CWE-1048: Invokable Control Element with Large Number of Outward Calls
https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/1048.html

Automated Source Code Maintainability Measure (ASCMMTM) V1.0
ASCMM-MNT-4 Callable and Method Control Element Number of Outward Calls
https://www.omg.org/spec/ASCMM/1.0/PDF
remediation: Review the design of the Procedure: move groups of related references into separate Procedures, so that each one depends on fewer Artifacts.
